tested_scope: One deterministic local Node.js v22.16.0 probe of one minimal raw-key guard over exactly two fixed top-level JSON object strings: an accept control with unique non-colliding decoded keys, and a reject payload containing one exact duplicate decoded key plus one distinct decoded-key pair colliding under Unicode NFC.
mechanism: Before ordinary JSON.parse object reconstruction, scan source-order JSON string tokens immediately preceding colons, decode each key token with JSON.parse, reject if a decoded key repeats exactly or if two distinct decoded keys normalize to the same NFC string; only materialize the object when no violation is observed.

reject_case.raw_shape: exact duplicate key dup plus NFC/NFD-equivalent key pair

scope_guard: Evidence is limited to these exact two fixed top-level JSON strings and this minimal scanner/runtime. It does not establish correctness for arbitrary nesting, escaped-key adversarial cases, non-object JSON, other runtimes, malformed JSON, parser differentials, performance, or standards-complete duplicate-key detection.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: after fresh authority freeze and own-state reconstruction, execute exactly one deterministic local escaped-key equivalence probe against the same pre-materialization guard. Use one accept control with unique escaped decoded keys and one reject payload where different raw key spellings decode to the same exact key and/or NFC-equivalent key. Verify rejection occurs before object materialization; persist only exact observed behavior and do not expand to nesting or malformed JSON in the same invocation.
